# YSU Online

> > Youngstown State University's online education platform offering accredited degree programs in nursing, business, healthcare, education, and applied sciences.

YSU Online provides flexible, career-focused programs including RN to BSN, MSN specialties, AACSB-accredited MBA, respiratory care degrees, and educational administration programs. The platform serves working professionals, military veterans, and students seeking advancement in healthcare, business, and education fields.

## Key Topics

- Youngstown State University (YSU)
- RN to BSN nursing advancement
- MSN nurse practitioner programs
- AACSB-accredited MBA
- Bachelor of Science in Applied Science (BSAS)
- Respiratory Care (BSRC, Master's)
- Educational Administration (M.S.Ed.)
- Online degree programs
- Nursing education and specialties
- Business leadership and management
- Healthcare professional advancement
- Military-friendly programs
- Family Nurse Practitioner (FNP)
- Adult-Gerontology Acute Care (AGACNP)
- Public Health education

## Admissions & Getting Started

- [Online Classes Admission - YSU](https://online.ysu.edu/admissions): YSU online admissions process with multiple start dates and flexible tuition
- [Career Resources For Military Veterans at YSU](https://online.ysu.edu/military-friendly-college-programs): Military veteran career resources and military-friendly online programs at YSU

## Nursing Programs

- [Online MSN AGACNP Program at Youngstown State University](https://online.ysu.edu/degrees/nursing/msn/agacnp): YSU's online Adult-Gerontology Acute Care Nurse Practitioner MSN program
- [Post Master's FNP Certificate Online Program at YSU](https://online.ysu.edu/degrees/nursing/post-masters-certificate/fnp): Youngstown State's online Family Nurse Practitioner post-master's certificate
- [YSU | Highest Paying Nursing Jobs - Salary Guide by Specialty](https://online.ysu.edu/degrees/nursing/msn/salary-guide-earning-potential): MSN salary guide and nursing specialty earnings potential overview
- [ASN vs. BSN: Differences and Nursing Career Impacts - YSU](https://online.ysu.edu/degrees/nursing/rn-to-bsn/asn-vs-bsn-career-comparison): ASN vs BSN nursing degree comparison and career advancement guide
- [A Guide to the Nursing Code of Ethics](https://online.ysu.edu/degrees/nursing/rn-to-bsn/the-nursing-code-of-ethics): Nursing Code of Ethics guide for professional standards and decision-making
- [Celebrate the Year of the Nurse and the Midwife: 2020 - YSU](https://online.ysu.edu/degrees/nursing/rn-to-bsn/year-of-the-nurse-and-midwife): WHO's 2020 Year of the Nurse recognition and nursing profession celebration

## Business Programs

- [Affordable Online MBA Programs at YSU | Finish in Just 12 Months!](https://online.ysu.edu/degrees/business/mba): AACSB-accredited online MBA programs at YSU, 12-month completion option
- [7 Skills in Business Leadership Skills to Cultivate - YSU Online](https://online.ysu.edu/degrees/business/mba/leadership-skills-to-cultivate): Seven essential business leadership skills for MBA professionals
- [Lacey Madison Adds Second Master's Degree in Online MBA Program - YSU](https://online.ysu.edu/degrees/business/mba/online-mba-lacey-madison): Lacey Madison's online MBA success story at Youngstown State University

## Healthcare Programs

- [Online Master of Respiratory Care Program | Youngstown State](https://online.ysu.edu/degrees/healthcare/masters-respiratory-care): YSU's online Master of Respiratory Care program for healthcare professionals
- [Online Bachelor of Science in Respiratory Care | YSU](https://online.ysu.edu/degrees/undergraduate/bsrc-degree-advancement): YSU's online BSRC Degree Advancement program for respiratory care professionals
